dedupe_keys.name: tum2twin multimodal urban digital twin benchmark dataset tum campus munich

description: TUM2TWIN is a multimodal benchmark dataset for urban digital twins covering the inner-city campus of the Technical University of Munich and its surroundings, created by a team from TUM, Munich University of Applied Sciences and the German Aerospace Center to make the campus one of the best-surveyed places on Earth. The paper describes 32 georeferenced, semantically aligned data subsets over about 100,000 m2 and 767 GB, including terrestrial, mobile, aerial and satellite observations, annotated point clouds, LoD2 and textured LoD2 building models, LoD3 building and vegetation models and road networks, with indoor and outdoor acquisition in a common reference system. The 3D models are in an LRZ GitLab repository (CityGML, FBX, OBJ, SketchUp, OpenDRIVE and GeoTIFF folders) and larger point clouds sit on dataset-specific storage; the site adds tutorials such as loading models into 3DCityDB and a facade point cloud benchmark. Coverage: the TUM city campus. Access: free download. Licence: CC BY 4.0 (repository licence). Caveats: a small area, so it serves method testing more than city-wide analysis. Simulation uses: validating 3D reconstruction, solar potential and digital twin workflows against high-accuracy ground truth. Related records: 3DCityDB and the official German LoD2 building model.
